goal: Add a new built-in rule 'has-license' to src/rule-engine/builtin-rules.ts that checks whether the repository has a LICENSE file. The rule should: (1) check for LICENSE, LICENSE.md, LICENSE.txt, or LICENCE files, (2) return a warning if no license is found, (3) include the rule in the default rules array. Add corresponding tests in tests/rule-engine.test.ts. All existing tests must continue to pass.
